job.purpose: S81 gather v4 'direct' cluster parent: 32 4-root leaves + 48 lane / result relays + ctl + 133 strip relays, wires only, one compensated clock entry per child (215); every leaf takes only its own lanes and returns only its own results (no through-leaf chain).

benches.name: gather_cl_gate
benches.cmd: SSA2=1 LOCAL_BANKS=1 CONTROL_STRIP=1 DIE_CLOCKS=1 SS=8 J=4 bash rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/test/run_gather_cl.sh $PWD {RUN}/gcl rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/test/real_order_trace.json '2 20'

benches.name: gather_cl_neg_lane
benches.cmd: RAW=1 MODES=lane SSA2=1 LOCAL_BANKS=1 CONTROL_STRIP=1 DIE_CLOCKS=1 SS=8 J=4 bash rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/test/run_gather_cl.sh $PWD {RUN}/gclm rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/test/real_order_trace.json '2 20'
